methodology.sbi_caveat: Absolute-control SBI may be negative when style deviates less than Paraphrase; signed SBI can cancel opposing biases. Neither guarantees absolute stability.
methodology.srr: mean(score(stronger) > score(weaker)); ties count as failures
methodology.awr: mean(score(high-substance plain) > score(low-substance persuasive)); ties count as failures
methodology.aggregation: Equal weight per eligible source/comparison/dimension observation. dimension_mean includes seven 1–5 dimensions only; overall_rating is separate (1–10). SRR/AWR primary results use overall_rating.
methodology.missing: Missing controls, missing drafts, invalid scores excluded, never imputed as zero. Plain is an explicit variant, never the source review.
methodology.comparison: paired_before and paired_final use exactly the same valid observations. before/final additionally report all available observations at each stage.
methodology.uncertainty: Descriptive metrics only; no confidence intervals. Pair membership is supplied by benchmark design, not inferred from model scores.
